row.notes: In Sess_VirtualSession_EstimateLapTime (0x142f6c8e0): lea rdx,[rsp+0x2c] right before call 0x142e80ce0 (tyre compound query, ctx=rcx, query=rdx). rcx = [[[rsi+0xa0]+0x28]+vehicle*8] (vehicle = bl of edx), loaded at 0x142f6ca49 and untouched by the compound table fill 0x142f6ca52..0x142f6ca92 (both the ja 0x142f6ca96 and fallthrough paths land here). A vehicle whose slot is null gives rcx=0 and 0x142e80ce0 faults reading 0x10 at F1_25.exe+0x2e80ce0 (rax=4 compound, rbx=vehicle). Core's estimate lap time guard hooks it; hook point is before the instruction. Needs L2 promotion by the session owner.
